prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the symptoms described, and the presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Initial evaluation documented concussion with headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. The patient has no known prior injury to the head or neck region.

Care over 21 visits included symptom monitoring, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, graduated return-to-activity guidance, and cognitive rest recommendations. The course followed a typical recovery pattern, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported substantial improvement and near-resolution of symptoms. Discharge from active care is anticipated pending final symptom check. Follow-up as needed is advised if symptoms recur.
